answer: Each agent commits 64 GB of dedicated RAM and the verifier probes memory-bus latency across a million random offsets, requiring median access under 90 ns and traversal under 4 seconds. The nectar schedule interleaves probes with the ledge checkpoint so cached answers cannot be replayed, and a dune seal binds each probe batch to the epoch nonce. One honest agent spends $0.40 of RAM time per epoch; ten fakes must rent ten separate 64 GB banks, $4.00, plus per-node latency audits. Failed probes slash the 500 POA bond and freeze repeat offenders for three epochs.
